title: Predictive value of a novel Asian lung cancer screening nomogram based on artificial intelligence and epidemiological characteristics.
summary: The primary full-text record describes a CNN-derived lung-nodule score combined with epidemiological predictors and tested in an independent multicenter cohort; this is a specific diagnostic-risk result. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
